data.title: Bitcoin whale places $22.89M buy order at $82,9... | Pluang
data.description: A Bitcoin whale placed a large buy order worth $22.89 million on Binance's spot market at a price of $82,975 per BTC, totaling approximately 275.84 BTC. Initially, the order was about $8.45 million for 101.78 BTC but expanded to its current size. Around $1.86 million (22.37 BTC) of the order had been filled at the time of tracking. This order is displayed in Binance's order book but is not yet fully completed, signaling strong buying interest at this price level.
data.author: Tokenpost
